params.name: ProgramId
params.description: Filter to clicks for a specific Program (formerly known as Campaign). Repeat the parameter to include multiple Programs.

params.name: AdId
params.description: Filter to clicks on a specific ad. Repeat the parameter to include multiple ads.

params.name: Date
params.description: Click date to export in `yyyy-MM-dd` format. Defaults to today if omitted.

params.name: SubId
params.description: Filter to clicks that include the specified Sub ID value. Repeat the parameter to include multiple Sub IDs.

params.name: UniqueClick
params.description: Set to `TRUE` to return only clicks that meet the IAB standards for a unique click. See the IAB Click Measurement Guidelines for details.

params.name: ResultFormat
params.description: Format for the exported result file.

items.docs:
Schedules a background job to asynchronously export clicks. Returns immediately with a `QueuedUri` pointing to the Partner Jobs API — poll that endpoint to track progress, then download the result from `ResultUri` once the job is complete.

**Migration note:** If you're migrating from the `Clicks` endpoint to `ClickExport`, note that the result object uses `ProgramId` and `ProgramName` in place of the previous `CampaignId` and `CampaignName`.

See the impact.com rate-limit documentation for this
